evidence.claim: Ebara produce elettropompe in acciaio inox per i mercati industriale e domestico europei, con lo stabilimento di Cles aperto nel 1992 e sede a Gambellara.
evidence.quote: the opening of the Cles plant (Trento province) in 1992 . It is one of Europe’s top manufacturing centres for stainless steel electric pumps || It would later go on to become EBARA Pumps Europe in 1998, with headquarters first in Brendola, and since 2018 in Gambellara , in Vicenza province || one of the biggest manufacturers of electric pumps for Europe’s industrial and domestic markets, operating in the drainage, waste water, industry, water supply and civil construction sectors
